+"""Standalone copy of Click's Windows console detection.
+
+``vendored_console_probe`` is ``click._winconsole._is_console`` copied
+verbatim so this file can be imported by path without importing Click.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import io
+import sys
+import typing as t
+from ctypes import byref
+from ctypes.wintypes import DWORD
+
+if sys.platform == "win32":
+    import msvcrt
+    from ctypes import windll
+
+    kernel32 = windll.kernel32
+    GetConsoleMode = kernel32.GetConsoleMode
+
+__all__ = ["vendored_console_probe", "vendored_console_probe_variant"]
+
+
+def vendored_console_probe(f: t.TextIO) -> bool:
+    if not hasattr(f, "fileno"):
+        return False
+
+    try:
+        fileno = f.fileno()
+    except (OSError, io.UnsupportedOperation):
+        return False
+
+    handle = msvcrt.get_osfhandle(fileno)
+    return bool(GetConsoleMode(handle, byref(DWORD())))
+
+
+def vendored_console_probe_variant(f: t.TextIO) -> bool:
+    """Like :func:`vendored_console_probe`, but a closed stream is never
+    a console.
+    """
+    if getattr(f, "closed", False) is True:
+        return False
+
+    return vendored_console_probe(f)

+import importlib.util
+import io
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import types
+
+import pytest
+
+MODULE_PATH = (
+    pathlib.Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_wave6_console_probe.py"
+)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def probe(monkeypatch):
+    name = "standalone_wave6_console_probe_under_test"
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "platform", "linux")
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, MODULE_PATH)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    assert "click" not in module.__dict__
+    return module
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def native(probe, monkeypatch):
+    calls = {"handles": [], "modes": []}
+
+    def get_osfhandle(fileno):
+        calls["handles"].append(fileno)
+        return 1000 + fileno
+
+    def get_console_mode(handle, mode_ref):
+        calls["modes"].append(handle)
+        return calls.get("result", 1)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        probe,
+        "msvcrt",
+        types.SimpleNamespace(get_osfhandle=get_osfhandle),
+        raising=False,
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(probe, "GetConsoleMode", get_console_mode, raising=False)
+    return calls
+
+
+class FakeStream:
+    def __init__(self, fileno=None, closed=False, error=None):
+        self._fileno = fileno
+        self.closed = closed
+        self._error = error
+
+    def fileno(self):
+        if self._error is not None:
+            raise self._error
+        return self._fileno
+
+
+def test_exports(probe):
+    assert probe.__all__ == [
+        "vendored_console_probe",
+        "vendored_console_probe_variant",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_console(probe, native):
+    assert probe.vendored_console_probe(FakeStream(1)) is True
+    assert native["handles"] == [1]
+    assert native["modes"] == [1001]
+
+
+def test_not_console(probe, native):
+    native["result"] = 0
+    assert probe.vendored_console_probe(FakeStream(2)) is False
+
+
+def test_no_fileno(probe, native):
+    assert probe.vendored_console_probe(object()) is False
+    assert native["handles"] == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("error", [OSError(), io.UnsupportedOperation()])
+def test_fileno_error(probe, native, error):
+    assert probe.vendored_console_probe(FakeStream(error=error)) is False
+    assert native["handles"] == []
+
+
+def test_empty_string_io(probe, native):
+    assert probe.vendored_console_probe(io.StringIO()) is False
+
+
+def test_other_error_propagates(probe, native):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        probe.vendored_console_probe(FakeStream(error=ValueError()))
+
+
+def test_vendored_ignores_closed(probe, native):
+    assert probe.vendored_console_probe(FakeStream(1, closed=True)) is True
+
+
+def test_variant_closed(probe, native):
+    assert probe.vendored_console_probe_variant(FakeStream(1, closed=True)) is False
+    assert native["handles"] == []
+
+
+def test_variant_closed_string_io(probe, native):
+    stream = io.StringIO()
+    stream.close()
+    assert probe.vendored_console_probe_variant(stream) is False
+
+
+def test_variant_open_delegates(probe, native):
+    assert probe.vendored_console_probe_variant(FakeStream(1)) is True
+    native["result"] = 0
+    assert probe.vendored_console_probe_variant(FakeStream(1)) is False
+
+
+def test_variant_empty_and_error(probe, native):
+    assert probe.vendored_console_probe_variant(io.StringIO()) is False
+    assert probe.vendored_console_probe_variant(object()) is False
+    stream = FakeStream(error=OSError())
+    assert probe.vendored_console_probe_variant(stream) is False
